name: The Heart Of Man
overview: Scripture reveals that the heart of man is inherently wicked and deceitful, as seen in Genesis where every imagination of the heart is continually evil from youth (Genesis 6:5; 8:21) and Jeremiah's declaration of its desperate wickedness (Jeremiah 17:9). Yet, God promises transformation by giving a new heart and spirit, replacing the stony, deceitful nature with one of flesh (Ezekiel 36:26). Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that life flows from it (Proverbs 4:23), and to seek God's cleansing and renewal for a right and pure heart (Psalms 51:10).
